t: A machine used used to process mobs and animals into $(l:agr_hus/meat)Liquid Meat$() and $(l:agr_hus/pink_slime)Pink Slime$(). The mobs killed by this machine will not produce drops or experience. $(br2)Passive mobs produce more pink slime than non passive ones
一台用于将生物和动物处理成 $(l:agr_hus/meat)肉汤$() 和 $(l:agr_hus/pink_slime)粉色史莱姆球$() 的机器。被这台机器杀死的生物不会掉落物品或经验。$(br2)被动生物产出的粉色史莱姆球比非被动生物更多
